mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear and it is 73 degrees at Harriet Park. We have a first quarter moon tonight, and you should keep an eye on the sky around 10:22 PM to see the International Space Station traveling from the Cross Plains direction in the northwest toward the Oregon area near Costco in the southeast, reaching about halfway up the sky.

Regarding city news, you can stay informed by watching VHAT on channel 989 or YouTube. Additionally, the city is promoting home composting as an easy way to manage food scraps, with a free drop-off site available at Badger Prairie County Park for registered users.

We have a busy day in Verona today. You can visit the Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, attend a yoga session at Insight Wellness, enjoy pizza at Lake Louie, or join in for Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, tomorrow you can enjoy Concerts in the Park at Century School Park or trivia at Hop Haus.
In our weekly police report, we noted an incident on July 13 where a 36-year-old man was arrested for an O-W-I after his vehicle became stuck on a rock.
Treat yourself to today's flavor, Mint Explosion. Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
